title: A girl at the school gate

cues.text: The school entranceway. You walk along the paved path between the planters, a bag over your shoulder, and Junpei jogs up behind you. A little way ahead, Aigis stands still by the planters, a bag in her hand, watching you.
Yukari walks up and joins you and Junpei.
Aigis turns and runs off past the planters, out of sight.
Junpei turns and walks off toward the school building, and you go with him. Yukari lingers a moment, then follows.
